stories.title: Extract the type scale into tokens.css (closes W-3) -- pure refactor
acceptance: add a type scale to specs/UI/tokens.css: --fs-hero / --fs-primary / --fs-secondary / --fs-label / --fs-meta (values SET in US-540; this story just establishes the tokens + wiring)
replace the ~83 hardcoded `font-size: Npx` in dashboard.css with token refs; DoD: NO bare `font-size: Npx` left in dashboard.css (a grep gate)
PURE REFACTOR -- no visual change vs the current shipped sizes (map each existing px to the nearest token, values unchanged here); ships + verifies independently of US-540
ruff/lint clean; a probe/test confirms zero bare px font-sizes remain

validationCriteria.action: grep dashboard.css for `font-size:` with a px literal after the refactor
validationCriteria.outcome: zero hardcoded px font-sizes; all reference the tokens.css scale; dashboard renders visually identical to before

conditionalOutcomes: US-539 is the HARD prerequisite for US-540 (Iris: without tokenizing first, US-540 becomes 83 edits that drift). No design gate -- pure refactor.
stories.goal: As a maintainer, I want font sizes to come from a small set of tokens so the legibility fix is one scale change, not 83 scattered edits that drift back.

stories.title: Set the type-scale token VALUES for 3.5in legibility (44/34/26/20/15)
acceptance: set the type-scale token values (Iris): hero 44 / primary 34 / secondary 26 / label 20 / meta 15 (px on the 480x320 stage). [FLOOR RULE] driver-must-read >= [EXACT:34]px; anything <26px non-critical only. Depends US-539 (tokens exist). Acceptance IN-CAR (arm's length, seated). CAVEAT: unverified panel downsampling may raise the floor -- re-verify on hardware, do NOT call values final. ruff clean

[Atlas display-pipeline finding] the deploy pins NO HDMI/KMS output mode -> the Pi likely outputs 1080p into a 480x320-native panel -> lossy scale-up-then-downsample softens every glyph (raises the floor). Acceptance: confirm output mode == panel native (or pin it -- see US-552) BEFORE calling the 44/34/26/20/15 values final. Re-verify the values AFTER the mode is confirmed

validationCriteria.action: in the car, seated normally, read the primary values on a card
validationCriteria.outcome: legible at arm's length; driver-must-read elements >=34px effective

stories.goal: As the operator, I want the primary values large enough to read at arm's length in the car.

stories.title: Re-lay the card set 4->6 for the legibility scale (Health card retires)
acceptance: with US-540-a's scale, capacity is ~3 facts/card (4 in a 2x2 ceiling). Card set 4->6: Home(live) . Alerts . System Status . Battery . Fuel Trim . Light. 'Health' RETIRES as a card (a container of 3 unrelated facts the scale can't afford) -- redistribute its facts. Sub-floor detail -> System drill-down (read parked). Partly reverses US-507/508 (intended). [ATLAS GATE] screen-count + US-482 letterbox-stage. Carousel handles N cards (no nav rework). ruff clean; probe confirms the 6-card set
[Atlas gate DoD] the carousel JS scales to N cards (verified count-agnostic); confirm no CSS #track / card-count cap assumes 4 (Iris presentation lane)

validationCriteria.outcome: 6 cards render (Health gone, facts redistributed); <=3-4 facts/card, all legible

stories.goal: As the operator, I want fewer facts per card so each one is legible at a glance.

stories.title: Atlas's 3 UI change requests -- IMU-always-on, card reorder, auto-rotate-off verify
acceptance: (1) [Atlas design-gate] IMU/heading ALWAYS-ON: the live IMU instrument is the permanent Home face (IMU is Pi-local, always-live). OBD-dependent bits (gear, altitude) render typed-NA/greyed via the honest-availability pattern (same as Battery/Light already do) -- never fabricated. Pairs with US-542 idle-face retirement
(2) reorder the carousel -> Home . Alerts . System Status . … (Alerts to 2nd). Pure dashboard.html markup order; the carousel finds the DTC index dynamically, so drill-down/takeover are unaffected
(3) auto-rotate OFF -- autoRotateS:0 (ALREADY landed via US-536/disposition-B); this story just VERIFIES it holds in the final card set
ruff/lint clean; probe confirms order + IMU-always-on + autoRotateS:0

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi, view the Home face parked (engine off) + swipe the carousel
validationCriteria.outcome: Home shows the live IMU instrument (heading/g real, OBD bits greyed-NA); order is Home.Alerts.System...; carousel does not auto-advance

conditionalOutcomes: IMU-always-on is Atlas-gated (touches the US-508 idle/live face). Reorder + auto-rotate-verify are independent/small.
stories.goal: As the operator, I want the live IMU instrument always visible, alerts second, and no auto-rotate, matching how I actually use the dashboard.

stories.title: Idle-face retirement -- STANDBY removed, DTC-since-key-off moves to Alerts
acceptance: [Atlas design-gate -- carries the only cross-card content move] retire the idle/standby face: parked, the IMU is CORRECT not unavailable (true heading, true 0.0 g), so the live Home card (US-541#1) covers it. Delete the STANDBY hero; move the clock to the top bar
move 'DTC not read since key-off' to the ALERTS card -- it was always an Alerts fact, borrowed by the idle face. No honest content lost
ruff/lint clean; probe confirms STANDBY gone + the DTC-since-key-off line lives on Alerts

[Atlas gate DoD] pin a test that the parked / auto-rotate-pause logic (carouselIdle/parkedNext) reads system-status, NOT the removed data-face -- so a future edit cannot re-couple them (the retirement is display-only, verified)

validationCriteria.action: park the Pi (engine off) and view Home + Alerts
validationCriteria.outcome: no STANDBY face (live IMU card is Home); clock in the top bar; 'DTC not read since key-off' shows on the Alerts card

conditionalOutcomes: Pairs with US-541#1 (IMU-always-on). Atlas gates the cross-card content move.
stories.goal: As the operator, I don't want a redundant STANDBY face -- parked, the live IMU card already shows the true state, so the idle face adds nothing.

stories.title: Pin Pi HDMI/KMS output to the panel-native 480x320 (kill downsampling)
acceptance: [Atlas A-16 display-pipeline fidelity] on the Pi (when on) read the actual output mode (kmsprint / xrandr). If it is NOT the panel's native 480x320, PIN the output to native in the deploy (KMS/HDMI mode). Eliminates the scale-up-then-downsample resampling AND renders the US-540 type scale 1:1 -- a distinct legibility lever alongside the font work
DoD: deploy sets the output mode; post-deploy the Pi reports the native mode; the type scale renders without resample-softening. ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi after deploy, read the active output mode + view a card
validationCriteria.outcome: output is the panel-native 480x320 (no 1080p downsample); glyphs render 1:1 sharp

conditionalOutcomes: Complements US-540 (fonts). If the mode is already native, this is a no-op verification. Pairs with US-540-a's re-verify-values-after-mode acceptance
stories.goal: As the operator, I want the Pi to render at the panel's native resolution so glyphs are 1:1 sharp, not softened by a 1080p->480x320 downsample.

validation.validationMethod: 3.5in legibility, IN-CAR acceptance (read at arms length, seated): (1) US-539 no bare px font-sizes left in dashboard.css (grep gate); (2) US-540-a driver-must-read >=34px effective; (3) US-540-b 6-card set renders (Health retired), <=3-4 facts/card; (4) US-541 IMU-always-on Home face + reorder + auto-rotate off; (5) US-542 no STANDBY face, DTC-since-key-off on Alerts; (6) US-552 output pinned to panel-native 480x320 (no 1080p downsample), glyphs 1:1. Re-verify the 44/34/26/20/15 values AFTER the output mode is confirmed.
